title: 日志、指标与 Trace：沿 IM 请求链留下有限证据
summary: 承接11.01业务确认点/分母与11.02分布，面向Go初学者用虚构m-a POST内存受理路径讲事件日志、Counter/Gauge/Histogram、trace/span上下文传播、采样、高基数标签与隐私、三类证据互补和当前S2不可观测的未来持久/设备/已读阶段。静态教材不运行监控。
objectives: 区分单次事件日志、聚合指标和一次请求追踪
为本章POST定义脱敏结构化日志字段
选择Counter/Gauge/Histogram并标单位与统计窗口
限制route/result等低基数标签避免user/message ID爆炸
说明trace采样不能替代完整失败计数
关联请求ID、消息ID和traceID但不混为同一身份
根据症状提出黑盒与白盒证据计划并标未覆盖阶段

sections.title: 一、从m-a结果未知选择三类证据
sections.focus: u-a/u-b/c-a/m-a虚构，当前无在线服务，09.04 POST内存提交后A没收到回应；日志回答此事件发生了什么，指标回答总体比例/队列，trace回答这次调用各阶段花多久。黑盒客户端观察vs白盒进程内部；三者不证明设备送达。

sections.title: 二、结构化日志：有限字段与阶段
sections.focus: Go slog概念，log event time level opID route template stage result/error_code duration_ms, response_committed, no raw body/token/real user id; error after commit vs before, requestID from trusted/generator and untrusted header, log count cardinality/cost, retention. Static example no runtime.

sections.title: 三、Counter、Gauge、Histogram与单位
sections.focus: counter monotonically increases until process restart/reset, attempts_total by bounded route/result, derive rate over window not take raw counter as throughput; gauge current in-flight/queue length goes up/down; histogram latency_seconds bucket/count/sum cumulative semantics and11.02 p99 approximation. No actual Prometheus; paper example100 attempts/92accepted, labels route=send result accepted/duplicate/invalid; do not conflate accepted with delivery. Explain process reset/multi instance aggregation caution。

sections.title: 四、标签基数与隐私成本
sections.focus: metric label bounded route/result/stage, example3 routes×4 results=12 series (before other dims), label user_id100k/message_id1m explodes and leaks; URL raw path c-a high cardinality vs route template, no body/token; logs/traces can carry controlled correlation with redaction/retention/access. Unit seconds for metric hist vs UI ms. High-cardinality risk performance and cost, not business issue solved by hashing ID alone。

sections.title: 五、Trace、Span和上下文传播
sections.focus: OpenTelemetry primary, one trace for request, root HTTP POST span children auth/app.Send/memorystore.Append/encode response; span start/end, parent, traceID/spanID attributes, events; r.Context propagation and cross process only if injected/extracted correctly; traceID not messageID, retries can have new trace same business message. Static 0/12/25/40ms from11.01 as paper; cross machine clock caveat. Sampling may omit rare errors, never use sampled traces as denominator。

sections.title: 六、把三种证据对齐一条请求
sections.focus: paper timeline u-a POST m-a -> memory commit -> response loss, log stage accepted, counter accepted increment, client sees timeout, trace maybe sampled shows memory append; neither proves A got200. Compare another invalid/bodytoo long, queue slow. Correlation key op_id/tracing and business message_id privacy, only authorized linkage; bounded metrics no ids. White/black box difference. Independent checkpoints.

sections.title: 七、观测缺口、采样与取舍
sections.focus: S2 only can plan request/inmemory; no real metrics, future durable/device/read missing, not zero. Sampling decisions error trace may be missed, logs may drop, counters may reset; single trace not represent population and p99 cannot identify root cause. Choose minimal fields, retention/access; future 11.04 diagnosis,11.08 SLO, 10.09 CI. No OpenIM runtime claims.

sections.title: 八、最小观测设计与22道练习
sections.focus: give one metric spec, one log event, one span tree, stage/error table, 22 questions from definitions/units/label count/correlation/sampling/IM evidence. Current no Go/metrics/tracing/benchmark/service, learner later separate actual observations. Sources GoogleSRE/OTel/Prometheus/slog, next10.09 CI or 11.04 S4; S2 next10.09 per roadmap。
